NewsArticle.Title: Art Class
NewsArticle.Content:
Teacher: Bentic
[Schedule](http://www.darkages.com/2000/community/news/class.html): Monday, Wednesday, Friday, Sunday at 5pm pst, unless otheriwse posted in the classroom
Location: Art/Literature Hall, Mileth College
My classes are Art Practice with a variety of materials, and almost always have a live aisling model to draw.
There isn't much in the way of a lecture, but I do help students with any problems they have during class working on their art.
Anyone is allowed to attend, but I do banish troublemakers. I appreciate if you leave your weapons at home when you come to class.
